title: tilia leucocarpa var. brevipedunculata
intro: Tilia leucocarpa var. brevipedunculata, commonly known as Chinese linden or small-fruit linden, is a plant species in the Tilia genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as fever, headaches, and anxiety, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tilia leucocarpa var. brevipedunculata include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and sedative effects, which may help alleviate pain and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
